title: 遺構の叙事詩 ―断罪の剣と約束の丘―
author: 竜胆 アルト

en.title: Epic of the Ruins: The Sword of Condemnation and the Hill of Promise
en.premise: The legendary 'Sword of Condemnation,' which once brought an end to the great war that split the world, was shattered alongside a solemn vow, its fragments lost to the shadows of history. Alvis, a young archivist, sets out for the 'Hill of Promise' mentioned in ancient texts, where he encounters Elysia, a knight stripped of her memories. Together, they must piece together the fragments of a forgotten myth and embark on a grueling pilgrimage to stop the resurrection of an ancient god intent on returning the world to the void.

zh.title: 遗构的叙事诗 ―断罪之剑与约定之丘―
zh.premise: 曾经终结了分断世界的战争之传说之剑——『断罪之剑』，在一段誓言中折断，其碎片散落在历史的阴影之中。年轻的记录官阿尔维斯在前往古籍记载的『约定之丘』的旅途中，邂逅了失去记忆的女骑士埃吕西亚。两人将拼凑起失落神话的碎片，投身于一场艰辛的巡礼，以阻止企图将世界归于虚无的古神再次降临。
